title: One-Punch Man Season 2 OVA
summary: AniList 108945 bundles the six OVAs that shipped as 映像特典 on the six SEASON 2 Blu-ray / DVD volumes: OVA 2 #01 サイタマとそこそこの能力者達 (vol 1, BCXA-1461 / BCBA-4961, 2019-10-25), #02 おっさん達と釣り (vol 2, BCXA-1462, 2019-11-26), #03 ジェノスと記憶喪失 (vol 3, BCXA-1463, 2019-12-25), #04 ゲームとライバル達 (vol 4, BCXA-1464, 2020-01-28), #05 ぷりぷりプリズナーと脱獄囚人達 (vol 5, BCXA-1465, 2020-02-27) and #06 ゾンビマン殺人事件２〜吹雪の山荘と寒がり達〜 (vol 6, BCXA-1466, 2020-03-27), each （約10分） — membership, disc, date and product code on TWO licensor lineages (the official site's six season2_N.php pages and Bandai Namco Filmworks' v-storage records), ja-WP's 第2期 BD/DVD table and en-WP's OVA table. NONE of the six adapts a printed unit of Murata's manga, and the licensor says so per volume: directly under each OVA's title in the 映像特典 block, both lineages print 「アニメ完全オリジナルストーリー」 — exactly once per page, six for six. ANN's announcement calls it 'the 10-minute original video anime (OVA) "#01" with a new story'; en-WP and ja-WP credit 脚本 稲本達郎 (#01/#02/#04/#06) and 鈴木智尋 (#03/#05). I re-ran the S1 sweep of the fandom's 45 bonus / extra chapters (vols 1-36, unchanged since wave 5; ja-WP's 19 named 番外編 all correspond to pages inside it) and none matches these six plots — the nearest neighbours are Prison (vol 4: Sonic's imprisonment, not Puri-Puri Prisoner's manhunt), Numbers (vol 10: Fubuki's video-game contest against Piko, not a national VR tournament) and Catch & Smash / Salmon (a fisherman, a suicidal man — not Bang and Atomic Samurai on a lake). The reverse index is empty too: not one Chapter or Volume page links to OVA 7-12 (backlinks fetched for all six — episode-nav transclusions, character /Other Media subpages, fight and image pages only). The nine characters these discs invented — Enjoe, Brut, Chemonille, Dirt Earthworm and The Mediocre Ability Users (#01), Giant Salamander (#02), Lord of Mountains (#03), TV Junkyard Monster and Urn Eel (#05), Bruinado (#06) — are every one `Anime Only Characters` + `OVA Only` with an empty manga field, and all sit on the wiki's curated Anime-Only Characters § OVAs tab; #04 invented no named character, and the wiki itself disambiguates its Garou-vs-Suiryu VR match from the manga's real fight ('much later in the story' — ch 236-237, the Neo Heroes arc, years after the OVA). Filler under T27, `chapters_adapted` empty and not even a sliver: the only source-adjacent frames are re-shown / retold beats of already-adapted material (#02's flashback cast — Melzargard, Iaian's lost arm, Garou — from the Dark Matter invasion animated in eps 11-12, ch 33-36; #05's spoken callback to Sonic escaping during the Seafolk attack of eps 9-10), which the recap clause makes weightless and uncitable. Two things worth the file: on S2 the licensor prints NO 原案 credit on the OVAs while printing 「プロット原案：ONE」 for the audio dramas on the same discs (the S1 volumes printed 「ONE原案による完全オリジナルストーリー」), and the last member's in-story setting is unpinned by every source I read — the position rests on the pinned members and the season seam.

position.why: Confirmed — 24.5 is the S2 seam (after the last TV episode the six discs carry; ep 24 = ch 83-85, our stored END) and it is safe for every member. Pinned windows: #02 opens at 12.5 (licensor 「ボロスの地球襲撃から1週間」; en-WP 'A week after the events of season 1 finale'); #03 after Fubuki's recruitment drive, which the run reaches in ep 14 → 14.5+; #05 after the Seafolk attack Sonic references → 10.5+; #04 is the LATEST pinned member — it needs Suiryu, whom the licensor's #17 synopsis introduces at the Super Fight, and shows him undefeated, which ends in ep 21 → 17.5-20.5. The last member #06 is UNPINNED: no licensor, wiki or WP text dates it (it is titled a sequel to S1's OVA #06, set after ep 12, and its four dispatched S-class heroes, Flashy Flash's vacation and Sonic's mountain training sit outside the Monster Association crisis of eps 17-24). So unlike the S1 bundle, 24.5 does not rest on the last member's setting — it rests on the latest pinned member plus the season seam, and the air-date derivation lands on the same value. Not the disc order: disc 2 ships the OVA set one week after ep 12.

flags_for_sean: BUNDLE (I46): six OVAs, one AniList id, ONE standing — and like the S1 bundle every member is an original, so filler with no mixed question to answer. If it is ever split, deliver WINDOWS, not disc equalities (the wave-5 verifier's finding 2): #01 unpinned, its only content clue the Mediocre Ability Users measuring themselves against Tatsumaki and Volten (Volten's TV introduction is ep 17, manga ch 60); #02 → 12.5 (「ボロスの地球襲撃から1週間」 / 'A week after the events of season 1 finale'); #03 → 14.5+ (Fubuki's Blizzard Group recruiting Genos; the run reaches her recruitment drive in ep 14); #04 → 17.5-20.5 (needs Suiryu, introduced at the Super Fight in ep 17, and shows him undefeated — he is broken in ep 21); #05 → 10.5+ (Sonic's callback to escaping Smelly Lid Prison during the Seafolk attack, eps 9-10); #06 → unpinned. The disc pairing is NOT the story order: disc 2 (eps 15-16) ships the OVA set one week after ep 12, and disc 4 (eps 19-20) ships the one that needs ep 17.

ONE'S 原案 — THE S2 DIFFERENCE, and it does not move the standing (T26). On S1 the licensor printed 「ONE原案による完全オリジナルストーリー」 on all six volumes; on S2 BOTH licensor lineages print 「アニメ完全オリジナルストーリー」 with no 原案 credit at all — while the SAME pages print 「プロット原案：ONE／脚本：鈴木智尋」 for the SPECIAL CD audio dramas on volumes 3-6, so the absence is the licensor's own practice, not an omission. ANN's S2 coverage never names ONE (its 2015 S1 report did: 'ONE will write the original story for all six OVAs'). ja-WP's one blanket sentence 「映像特典としてONE原案による完全オリジナルストーリーのOVAを収録。」 sits above BOTH season tables and so reads as a claim for both. Either reading, 原案 is a CREDIT recorded in the note, never an adoption — nothing of these six stories ever entered Murata's line: adopted = null.

DATE SPAN + DURATION: AniList's single 2019-10-25 is disc 1's date alone; the bundle runs 2019-10-25 → 2020-03-27 (10-25 / 11-26 / 12-25 / 01-28 / 02-27 / 03-27) on two licensor lineages, ja-WP and en-WP. AniList's 12-minute duration is a class off: the licensor prints （約10分） for all six and ANN / en-WP call them '10-minute' OVAs. AniList's GraphQL endpoint answered 403 ('temporarily disabled') throughout — every fact here comes from a page I fetched raw, none from AniList and none from memory. No repair proposed because the context shows no stored date or duration on the row; if either is ever stored, these are the honest values.

SOURCE DEFECT for any later date join: the fandom's OVA 8 page prints 'release date = November 25, 2019' against the licensor ×2 + ja-WP + en-WP's November 26. Unlike the S1 set (where en-WP's OVA dates were wrong for five of six), en-WP's S2 OVA dates are all correct — trust en-WP here, not the fandom's OVA-page field.

THE INSTRUMENT'S SILENCE IS MEANINGFUL, and I proved the field is sensitive: the fandom's per-episode `chapters =` field for S2 is page-partitioned (ep 17 = 58, 59, 60 (pp 1-12, 14-27), 61 (pp 1-22, 25-30); ep 21 = 75, 76 (pp 1-10, 12, 14-17), 77, 78 (pp 1-26, 29-41), 79 (pp 1-7)) and it agrees with our anchors at the seam (ep 24 = ch 83, 84, 85 = our stored END 85; MU's segment 'Vol 7, Chap 37 (S2)' → 'Vol 17, Chap 85 (S2)' agrees). The same field NAMES A BONUS CHAPTER when one is adapted — ep 18 = ch 60 (p 13), 62-66, plus 'Star (pages 3-4)', the vol-13 extra. So the OVA pages' chapterless {{Infobox movie}} and the zero chapter backlinks are a positive silence, not a data gap.

OUT OF SCOPE, noted so a later sweep does not mistake them for OVAs: the S2 discs also carry four ONE-plotted AUDIO DRAMAS on SPECIAL CDs (vol 3 「サイタマと完全な休日」, vol 4 「サイタマと幻のヒロイン」, vol 5 「サイタマと怪人の名乗り」, vol 6 「サイタマと"ジェノス最強化計画"」 — all プロット原案：ONE／脚本：鈴木智尋) and five 「帰って来た！マジ特番」 promo specials. None is animation, none is in AniList 108945, none holds a manga unit.

SIBLING CONSISTENCY (R25): this verdict reuses one-punch-man__21416's method AND its verifier's corrections — the 45-bonus-chapter sweep re-run today (same 45 members, no continuation token; ja-WP's 19 named 番外編 all inside it), windows instead of disc equalities, and the credit form for 原案. The owner's three extras rows now read: @9.5 Road to Hero filler, @12.5 the S1 OVA bundle filler, @24.5 the S2 OVA bundle filler. No Swim-shaped design crossing this time: all nine S2-invented characters carry an empty manga field and both `Anime Only Characters` and `OVA Only`.

THE HONEST GAP: OVA 2 #06's in-story setting is unpinned. Its title makes it a sequel to S1's OVA #06 (set after the Boros invasion), and its content — four S-class heroes dispatched on a leisurely monster hunt, Flashy Flash on vacation, Sonic training on the mountain — sits outside the Monster Association crisis of eps 17-24, but no licensor synopsis, wiki page or WP summary dates it. Watching the OVA would settle it (Genos's parts: ep 23 re-equips him with new ones). It does not move the verdict: 24.5 is the season seam and is safe for all six either way.
